review_evidence: README identifies Solanalib as a Lean library of formal Solana models and verified theorems, including account/finance abstractions and bit-precise sBPF semantics, decoder, interpreter and verifier.

Test- and executable-named sources were inspected rather than blanket-excluded: VerifierTest proves concrete verifier/safety statements, GrowthTest instantiates bundled decay/growth theorems, and Oracle.lean defines a reusable differential-testing front end over the formal interpreter.

Complete lakefile.lean inspection found package/linter settings, dependencies, library/test targets and an executable target only; those settings do not contain the modeled semantics or verification results.
